name: PayPal
description: Two-way PayPal sync: import PayPal invoices as fully structured documents, push InvoiceLeaf invoices to PayPal for payment collection, and record PayPal payments. Payments matched to synced invoices mark them as paid automatically.

apiKey.instructions: Create a REST app in the PayPal Developer Dashboard (Apps & Credentials) and paste the app's Client Secret here. The Client ID and the environment (live or sandbox) are not secret and are entered in the integration settings.

triggers.name: Import PayPal Invoices
triggers.description: Imports invoices created in PayPal Invoicing into InvoiceLeaf as fully structured documents

triggers.name: Sync PayPal Payments
triggers.description: Records PayPal invoice payments and successful transactions as payments and allocates them to synced invoices

triggers.name: Push Invoices to PayPal
triggers.description: Creates PayPal invoices from unpaid InvoiceLeaf receivable invoices so customers can pay them via PayPal

actions.name: Test PayPal Connection
actions.description: Verify the REST app credentials can obtain an OAuth token and read invoices

clientId.title: PayPal Client ID
clientId.description: The Client ID of your PayPal REST app. Required for the integration to work.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: PayPal environment the REST app belongs to.

initialSyncLookbackHours.title: Initial Sync Lookback (hours)
initialSyncLookbackHours.description: Used only until the first successful run checkpoint is stored.

importDraftInvoices.title: Import Draft Invoices
importDraftInvoices.description: When disabled, draft invoices are skipped until they are sent.

recordUnmatchedTransactions.title: Record Unmatched Transactions
recordUnmatchedTransactions.description: When enabled, successful PayPal transactions that do not belong to a synced invoice are recorded as unmatched payments for manual reconciliation. Requires the Transaction Search feature to be enabled on the REST app.

autoSendInvoices.title: Auto-Send Pushed Invoices
autoSendInvoices.description: Send pushed invoices through PayPal immediately. This emails the invoice to the customer. When disabled, pushed invoices stay as PayPal drafts.

configGroups.title: Invoice Push
configGroups.description: How InvoiceLeaf invoices are pushed to PayPal
